ESTADO.SEM_CONFIGURACAO: The Clinical Kanban is not configured on this installation. Set FOCOH_SUPABASE_URL and FOCOH_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in the environment and restart the application.
ESTADO.SEM_PAPEL_CLINICO: Your user has no clinical role assigned in the Rede Focoh Kanban. Without one the board would render empty, which is not the same as having no admitted patients. Request the assignment from the Technical Coordination.
ESTADO.PAPEL_CLINICO_INVALIDO: The clinical role assigned to your user is not recognised by the Kanban. This indicates a configuration error — notify the Technical Coordination.
ESTADO.SEM_TOKEN: Could not authenticate with Supabase to load the board. Try again; if the problem persists, notify the Technical Coordination.

BLOQUEIO.FALLBACK: Advance Blocked: Phase transition requires approval of the 3 Weekly Reports (Clinical, Therapeutic and Disciplinary) and no active risks. Check pending items with the Technical Coordination.

ADMISSAO.SUBTITULO: Identification and Support Network — creates the patient record
ADMISSAO.BLOCO_ENVIADO: Block recorded in the clinical file.
ADMISSAO.CRIADO: Patient admitted. The card will appear in the Admission column.

BLOCO.CAMPOS_OBRIGATORIOS_FALTANDO: {n} required field missing | {n} required fields missing

PROGRESSAO.ENVIADO: Block recorded. The phase lock is automatically re-evaluated.
PROGRESSAO.SEM_TRANSICAO: This patient is in Discharge/Transition — there is no next phase to assess.

LAUDO.ENVIADO: Report recorded. Continue with the remaining blocks.

RISCO.SUBTITULO: {nome} — inverted score: low score = high risk
RISCO.ENVIADO: Assessment registered. The risk classification has been recalculated.

CONFIGURACOES.DESCRICAO: Properties, users and data for the Clinical Kanban. Larger changes (new field type, new stage, new automation) must be coordinated with Sancar.
CONFIGURACOES.SEM_PERMISSAO_EDICAO: You can view, but only technical coordination, management or a configuration editor can make changes.
CONFIGURACOES.ERRO_SALVAR: Could not save. Please try again.

IMPORTAR_EXPORTAR.EXPORTAR_DESCRICAO: Downloads all configured properties as JSON.
IMPORTAR_EXPORTAR.IMPORTAR_DESCRICAO: Loads a file for review. Actual import (writing to the database) is not yet available in this version — contact Sancar to migrate a large catalogue.
IMPORTAR_EXPORTAR.ARQUIVO_LIDO: File read: {n} properties. Review in the console before applying manually.
IMPORTAR_EXPORTAR.ARQUIVO_INVALIDO: Invalid file — expected a JSON exported by this screen.
